title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-50560)
description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the wso2am package related to the Netty network application framework. This vulnerability affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The issue has a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating a medium severity level, and impacts availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
